prompt: Create a production sprite animation sheet using the supplied reference ONLY for character identity, costume, proportions and pixel art rendering. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, NO TEXT OR GRIDLINES. Bottom two rows = ONE continuous 10-frame RUN LOOP. Critical: anatomically real bilateral gait, clearly DIFFERENT LEG POSES each frame; alternate left and right leg forward every half cycle. Run similarly full bilateral cycle with clear bent knees, heel recovery near buttocks and flight phases, torso modestly leaned forward. Hold weapon consistently safely near side, no attack. Fabric/hair follow movement subtly, feet have consistent floor baseline except true flight poses. Keep head and hips centered per cell, no camera movement. Match the reference's character exactly; do NOT repeat a static pose or slide whole character. Never mirror facing direction. Crisp detailed game sprite pixel artwork.
